mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of the 20-day periods following a 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS, the S&P 500 produces negative returns, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate to below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profits and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE drops below 5.0%, the S&P 500 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC is negative over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, which together drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of persistent inflation above 2.0% (CPIAUCSL > 2.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0% YoY, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is negative over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns following a 6-month rising PAYEMS trend are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (base 2017=100) signals an economic slowdown, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO drops below 100.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is negative over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts above 600.0 thousand units signals strong residential investment and economic confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 600.0, the S&P 500 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates expanding manufacturing output, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns following a 3-month rising INDPRO trend are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year window.
